# proxmox_sdn_zone (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox VE SDN zone through `/cluster/sdn/zones`. Supports the `simple`, `vlan`, `qinq`, `vxlan`, `evpn`, and `faucet` zone types with typed fields per type. Writes stay staged until `proxmox_sdn_apply` commits the whole SDN configuration; Proxmox reloads every node's network on commit. Destroy only removes the staged zone, and Proxmox refuses to delete a zone that a VNet still uses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Zones stay staged until proxmox_sdn_apply commits the configuration.
# Provider credentials need SDN.Allocate on /sdn and /sdn/zones.

# A plain zone without type-specific fields.
resource "proxmox_sdn_zone" "lab" {
  zone  = "lab"
  type  = "simple"
  nodes = ["node1", "node2"]
}

# A VLAN zone bound to the VLAN-aware bridge whose VLANs it manages.
# `dns` and `ipam` reference SDN DNS and IPAM object ids.
resource "proxmox_sdn_zone" "vlan" {
  zone   = "vz100"
  type   = "vlan"
  nodes  = ["node1", "node2"]
  bridge = "vmbr1"
  mtu    = 9000

  dns     = "dns1"
  dnszone = "example.com"
  ipam    = "pve"
  dhcp    = "dnsmasq"
}

# A VXLAN zone tunnelling to the node IPs, with an explicit UDP port.
resource "proxmox_sdn_zone" "vx" {
  zone       = "vxz1"
  type       = "vxlan"
  peers      = ["10.0.0.1", "10.0.0.2"]
  vxlan_port = 4789
}

# An EVPN zone with its required controller and VRF VNI.
resource "proxmox_sdn_zone" "evpn" {
  zone                       = "evz1"
  type                       = "evpn"
  controller                 = "evpn-controller"
  vrf_vxlan                  = 10000
  exitnodes                  = ["node1"]
  exitnodes_local_routing    = true
  advertise_subnets          = true
  disable_arp_nd_suppression = false
  mac                        = "AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF"
}

# A QinQ zone needs the outer service VLAN tag and a bridge.
resource "proxmox_sdn_zone" "qinq" {
  zone          = "qz1"
  type          = "qinq"
  bridge        = "vmbr1"
  tag           = 100
  vlan_protocol = "802.1ad"
}

# A faucet zone needs a controller and the dataplane id.
resource "proxmox_sdn_zone" "faucet" {
  zone       = "fz1"
  type       = "faucet"
  controller = "faucet-controller"
  dp_id      = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Zone type: `simple`, `vlan`, `qinq`, `vxlan`, `evpn`, or `faucet`. Changes require replacement.
- `zone` (String) SDN zone identifier: starts with a letter, only letters and digits, 2 to 8 characters. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `advertise_subnets` (Boolean) Advertise IP prefixes (Type-5 routes) instead of MAC/IP pairs (Type-2).
- `bridge` (String) Bridge whose VLANs the zone manages. Required for `vlan` and `qinq`, not allowed elsewhere.
- `bridge_disable_mac_learning` (Boolean) Disable MAC learning on the `vlan`/`qinq` zone bridge.
- `controller` (String) SDN controller of an `evpn` or `faucet` zone.
- `dhcp` (String) DHCP backend for a `simple` zone; Proxmox currently only knows `dnsmasq`.
- `disable_arp_nd_suppression` (Boolean) Disable ARP/ND suppression for the `evpn` zone.
- `dns` (String) ID of the DNS server used by this zone.
- `dnszone` (String) Domain name of the zone. Requires `dns`.
- `dp_id` (Number) Faucet dataplane id of a `faucet` zone.
- `exitnodes` (Set of String) `evpn` exit nodes.
- `exitnodes_local_routing` (Boolean) Let `evpn` exit nodes connect to EVPN guests.
- `exitnodes_primary` (String) `evpn` exit node that traffic must pass first.
- `fabric` (String) SDN fabric used as the underlay of a `vxlan` zone.
- `ipam` (String) ID of the IPAM used by this zone. Proxmox refuses to change it while the zone already has subnets.
- `mac` (String) Anycast logical router MAC address of an `evpn` zone.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU for the bridges created for this zone's VNets.
- `nodes` (Set of String) Cluster nodes the zone is created on. Proxmox stores them comma separated in sorted order.
- `peers` (Set of String) Peer IP addresses of a `vxlan` zone; Proxmox stores them comma separated in sorted order.
- `reversedns` (String) ID of the reverse DNS server used by this zone.
- `rt_import` (String) Route targets imported into the `evpn` zone VRF.
- `secondary_controllers` (Set of String) Additional `evpn` controllers.
- `tag` (Number) Outer service VLAN tag of a `qinq` zone, between 2 and 4094.
- `vlan_protocol` (String) VLAN protocol of a `qinq` zone: `802.1q` (the Proxmox default) or `802.1ad`.
- `vrf_vxlan` (Number) VNI of the `evpn` zone VRF, between 1 and 16777215.
- `vxlan_port` (Number) VXLAN UDP port, the Proxmox default is 4789.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Zone identifier (same as `zone`).
- `pending` (Map of String) Properties Proxmox currently reports as staged but not committed, with `deleted` for removals.
- `state` (String) Proxmox staging state: `new` or `changed` while the zone is not committed yet.
